shots.description: Twelve finishes on the same part, each beside its chart swatch (from reports/4-materials.png).
Designer Studio: the way into the editor from the catalogue.
Metal Shank Button: the editor as it opens — product, finish, branding and output.
The finish picker: the WIN-CYC chart filtered by axis — Brushed and Nickel ticked.
Gold plating rendered from the finish's measured reflectance, not a guessed colour.
Anti brass: an antique two-tone, oxide in the recesses from a baked occlusion pass.
The ruler: diameter and thickness measured off the model itself, in millimetres.
Add text: the layer lands where the factory's own branding was, with its handles on the model.
Position and curve: every spatial value as a number and a slider, the number authoritative.
The bottom arc: text reads left to right along the inside of the circle, never mirrored.
Straight layout: the same layer, laid flat across the face.
The ruler follows the selected layer: letter height and the margin left to the edge.
Add logo: an uploaded SVG becomes engravable outlines, holes and all.
Three layers: reorder, delete, undo and redo — every change is one entry.
Anonymous buyer: the editor works before sign-in, with the banner offering to save the design.
390 px: the viewport keeps its height and the panel stacks under it, controls and all.
The CMS: one .obj per product, its raw dimensions read on upload and its scale confirmed.
The recovered text path drawn on the model: radius, arc and where buyers' text will start.
Preview as buyer: the factory lettering hidden, which is what the buyer starts from.
Two-point calibration: click two points whose real distance is known and the scale follows.
Marking the factory lettering: 28 groups, analysed into one sentence a person can check.
